condition_descriptions.single_t{t}: hinted run; the INPUT vector of latent slot t replaced by the same question's natural UNHINTED state (shorter prompt, so shifted absolute positions); later slots and the answer recomputed; slots can still attend to the hinted prompt
condition_descriptions.single_pm_t{t}: as single_t but the donor is the position-matched run (hinted prompt, hint tokens hidden from attention, same position ids)
condition_descriptions.noise_t{t}: slot t input replaced by Gaussian noise with the norm of the unhinted donor state
condition_descriptions.matched_t{t}: slot t input replaced by the unhinted state of ANOTHER question (same group and depth where known)
condition_descriptions.samecond_t{t}: slot t input replaced by the hinted state of another question of the same group
condition_descriptions.reverse_t{t}: UNHINTED run; slot t input replaced by the same question's hinted state (change relative to the unhinted M)
condition_descriptions.persist_t{t}: slots 0 and t replaced by unhinted states; slots t+1.. cannot attend to the hint span or <bot>; slot t and earlier cached states may have seen the hint (secondary)
condition_descriptions.*_mean: row-level mean of the six per-step conditions of that family (single_mean is the registered primary)
condition_descriptions.full6: all six slot inputs replaced by natural unhinted states; the hinted prompt stays accessible to the slots and to the answer
condition_descriptions.zero_full6: all six slot inputs replaced by zeros (scale control); hinted prompt stays accessible
condition_descriptions.matched_full6: all six slot inputs replaced by another question's unhinted states (scale control); hinted prompt stays accessible
condition_descriptions.full6_pm: all six slot inputs replaced by position-matched states; hinted prompt stays accessible
condition_descriptions.block_answer: answer positions cannot attend to the hint span or <bot>; the latents run unchanged and may carry the hint
condition_descriptions.block_latents: slot 0 input replaced by the unhinted state, and latent steps cannot attend to the hint span or <bot>; the answer can still read the hint directly
condition_descriptions.block_latents_pm: as block_latents with the position-matched slot-0 state
condition_descriptions.block_latents_mad: as block_latents with slot 0 from the matched-attention donor run (hint hidden, <bot> blocked)
condition_descriptions.full6_block_answer: all six inputs replaced by unhinted states and the answer blocked from the hint span and <bot>; slots can still attend to the hint
condition_descriptions.both_blocked: all six inputs replaced by unhinted states, latents AND answer blocked from the hint span and <bot>: no route from the hint remains
condition_descriptions.both_blocked_pm: as both_blocked with position-matched donor states
condition_descriptions.both_blocked_mad: as both_blocked with donor states produced under the same blocked-attention regime
condition_descriptions.f_ans_hint / f_ans_bot / f_ans_both: FOLLOW-UP: the answer cannot attend to the hint tokens only / to <bot> only / to both (= block_answer); latents untouched
condition_descriptions.f_lat_hint / f_lat_bot: FOLLOW-UP: latent steps (from slot 0) cannot attend to the hint tokens only / to <bot> only; slot-0 input is NOT replaced; the answer reads everything
condition_descriptions.f_lat_hint_ans_hint / f_lat_bot_ans_bot: FOLLOW-UP: the same single-target block applied to both latent steps and the answer
condition_descriptions.f_u_ans_bot / f_u_lat_bot_ans_bot: FOLLOW-UP disruption baselines: <bot> alone blocked on UNHINTED prompts; change relative to the unhinted M
condition_descriptions.u_block_latents / u_block_answer / u_bot: disruption baselines: the same blocks applied to UNHINTED prompts (<bot> blocked); change relative to the unhinted M, i.e. what blocking does with no hint present
